pages.text: The $(item)Stirling Engine$() generates $(thing)Forge Energy (FE)$() by harvesting heat from hot blocks placed directly beneath it. It is the built-in power source for a TremendousStorage network and requires no fuel items.

pages.title: Heat Sources
pages.text: Place one of the following blocks $(bold)directly under$() the Stirling Engine:$(br2)$(bold)Lava block$() — highest output$(br)$(bold)Magma block$() — medium output$(br)$(bold)Lit Campfire$() — low output$(br2)The engine's flywheel animates while it is actively producing power. Output is pushed to all adjacent blocks that accept FE.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Storage Upgrade$() — raises the tier and significantly increases power output at each step:$(br2)Wood → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite$(br2)The engine also stores FE internally and pushes energy each tick to neighbouring handlers, smoothing out delivery to large networks.
